title: HOW could ancient artisans quarry 60 tons of basalt every single hour with manual hammers? #Shorts
description:
HOW could ancient artisans quarry 60 tons of basalt every single hour with manual hammers?

If completed in 18 years as royal copper plates state, workers had to remove 5 metric tons of basalt per hour, 24 hours a day, non-stop. Modern pneumatic drills in mining struggle to maintain that volumetric extraction rate in dense tholeiitic basalt (Mohs hardness 6).

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
